issues.explanation: Ep1 showed Vanessa as Adrian's glamorous companion and a diner customer who insulted Maya, with no sign she manages the diner. Ep2 has Maya identify Vanessa as the manager who sent the firing text, so the roles conflict.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the line so the text comes from Maya's diner manager and Maya whispers that Vanessa must have complained, e.g. 'Vanessa did this.'
